why_trail.why: #464 rename design settled. NEW FIELD NAME: 'Episode' (was 'Lesson'), matching the doctrine vocabulary in docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md ('episode' = one stored record) and the CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK.template.md's own already-updated prose ('originating episode id from episodes/'). MUST-CHANGE (3 files, one change): (1) skills/workbench/templates/CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK.template.md line 23 field list '- **Lesson:**' -> '- **Episode:**' plus header prose lines 12-19 (drop the now-false 'field keeps its old name' parenthetical). (2) .agent-work/CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK.md header prose lines 1-19: resync to match the template's corrected episode-based wording (this file's header is STALE pre-#447 text -- still says 'constellation-scoped lesson' and 'amend-ing the lesson', a retired-playbook verb episodes do not have -- bring it in line with the template, same field rename). Its 3 narrative '**Lesson:**' lines at 140/173/216 are pre-#447 lesson-slug values (not episode ids, not machine-parsed -- no '### ' subheading wraps them so parse_prose_findings finds nothing there) and are LEFT UNTOUCHED as historical record, matching how RETURN.md/docs/RECURSIVE_IMPROVEMENT_DESIGN.md are treated elsewhere in this repo ('reconciling a record would falsify history'). (3) scripts/collect_feedback.py: fingerprint()/fingerprints() read entry.get('episode') first, fall back to entry.get('lesson') -- the fallback is REQUIRED, not cosmetic: it keeps parsing (a) any not-yet-upgraded external project's field-format export still spelling 'Lesson', and (b) the network_elo prose-heading shape ('### Lesson: <slug>') and story_time inline-prose shape ('**Lesson:** <id>' inside a '### ...' sub-block) -- both are OTHER repos' literal file content via _PROSE_LABELS/PROSE_HEADING_RE, deliberately NOT renamed since we cannot rename what another project's file literally says. The internal hash prefix stays the literal string 'lesson:' (an opaque identity-scheme tag, decoupled from the display label) so every fingerprint already recorded in CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK.collected.json / CONSTELLATION_INBOX.json keeps matching -- renaming that prefix would silently orphan every previously-filed finding's identity and cause duplicate re-filing. TESTS (tests/test_feedback_tooling.py): rename test_lesson_id_groups_across_slug_drift -> test_episode_id_groups_across_slug_drift (field line '- **Episode:**'); rename test_lesson_id_takes_precedence_over_slug -> test_episode_id_takes_precedence_over_slug (entry key 'episode'); ADD test_legacy_lesson_field_format_still_fingerprints (old '- **Lesson:**' field-format doc still fingerprints -- backward-compat guard for un-upgraded external projects); ADD test_episode_field_takes_precedence_over_legacy_lesson_field (entry carrying BOTH keys -> episode wins, proves the new fallback order). Leave test_prose_finding_surfaced_network_elo_shape / test_prose_finding_fingerprints_on_inline_lesson_id / test_field_and_prose_not_double_counted untouched (external-format tests, not this repo's field). ENUMERATION already run: grep -rn -e '\*\*Lesson\[:*\]' -e '"lesson"' -e \'lesson\' -e 'Lesson field' scripts/ .agent-work/CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK.md skills/workbench/templates/CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK.template.md tests/test_feedback_tooling.py -> 12 hits: 3 in collect_feedback.py (code, change), 1 in CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK.md:14 (header, change), 3 in CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK.md:140/173/216 (historical narrative, leave), 2 in template.md:14+23 (change), 2 in test file (rename), 3 in test file (external-shape tests, leave). A broader unscoped repo grep for the same tokens returns 117 hits total, ~20 outside .agent-work archive dirs -- the rest are archived/historical run snapshots (RETURN.md, docs/superpowers/*, .agent-work/archive|epic-*/harvest|staged-feedback|harvest-*|dispatch-*) that are frozen closed-run records, git-tracked on purpose, out of scope (rewriting them would misrepresent history, same principle RETURN.md itself states for docs/RECURSIVE_IMPROVEMENT_DESIGN.md). NOT YET DONE: none of the above edits have been made yet -- this is pure design captured before implementation, filed here because a HARD context trip (gauge 19% fill, hard cap 150K tokens for claude-sonnet-5) blocked advancing past m0-context. Next actor: attach the refresh-request is already done (e-m0-context-1); start m1-rename and execute exactly the file list above.

Hash prefix stayed literal 'lesson:'. The 3 historical narrative Lesson: lines (140/173/216) and the network_elo/story_time prose-shape handling (_PROSE_LABELS['lesson']) were left untouched per design. TDD: attested c1 red (3 of 4 named tests failed pre-rename, the legacy-Lesson-field test already passed since that path was unchanged), then implemented, then the 4 named tests + the full test_feedback_tooling.py suite (33 tests) went green. No scope creep beyond the 3 files + tests.
